question: Under what condition does the prescribed mantra recitation become fruitless?
premises: A state of trembling is present.
The recitation in question is that recitation.
The result in that condition is fruitlessness.
inference: When there is trembling, that recitation becomes fruitless.
uncertainties: Whether cañcale refers to mental or physical instability is not explicit.
plain_english: O beautiful-limbed one, when there is trembling, that recitation would be fruitless.
